sourceChecks.text: Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount of Bethel, and one thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah of Benjamin. He sent the rest of the people to their own tents.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ヨナタンとギベアの千人を記す。サウルとの親子関係はこの節にはない。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan struck the garrison of the Philistines that was in Geba, and the Philistines heard of it. Saul blew the trumpet throughout all the land, saying, “Let the Hebrews hear!”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ヨナタンがゲバの守備隊を打ったと記す。サウルとの親子関係はこの節にはない。

sourceChecks.text: Saul, and Jonathan his son, and the people who were present with them, stayed in Geba of Benjamin; but the Philistines encamped in Michmash.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 「Jonathan his son」と明記され、サウルの子との関係が初めて示される。

sourceChecks.text: So it came to pass in the day of battle that neither sword nor spear was found in the hand of any of the people who were with Saul and Jonathan; but Saul and Jonathan his son had them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Now it happened on a day that Jonathan the son of Saul said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the Philistines’ garrison that is on the other side.” But he didn’t tell his father.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: including Ahijah the son of Ahitub, Ichabod’s brother, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli the priest of the LORD in Shiloh, wearing an ephod. The people didn’t know that Jonathan was gone.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines’ garrison, there was a rocky crag on the one side and a rocky crag on the other side; and the name of the one was Bozez, and the name of the other Seneh.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan said to the young man who bore his armor, “Come! Let’s go over to the garrison of these uncircumcised. It may be that the LORD will work for us, for there is no restraint on the LORD to save by many or by few.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then Jonathan said, “Behold, we will pass over to the men, and we will reveal ourselves to them.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: The men of the garrison answered Jonathan and his armor bearer, and said, “Come up to us, and we will show you something!” Jonathan said to his armor bearer, “Come up after me, for the LORD has delivered them into the hand of Israel.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan climbed up on his hands and on his feet, and his armor bearer after him, and they fell before Jonathan; and his armor bearer killed them after him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: That first slaughter, which Jonathan and his armor bearer made, was about twenty men, within as it were half a furrow’s length in an acre of land.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then Saul said to the people who were with him, “Count now, and see who is missing from us.” When they had counted, behold, Jonathan and his armor bearer were not there.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Now the Hebrews who were with the Philistines before and who went up with them into the camp from all around, even they also turned to be with the Israelites who were with Saul and Jonathan.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: But Jonathan didn’t hear when his father commanded the people with the oath. Therefore he put out the end of the rod that was in his hand and dipped it in the honeycomb, and put his hand to his mouth; and his eyes brightened.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then Jonathan said, “My father has troubled the land. Please look how my eyes have brightened because I tasted a little of this honey.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: For as the LORD lives, who saves Israel, though it is in Jonathan my son, he shall surely die.” But there was not a man among all the people who answered him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then he said to all Israel, “You be on one side, and I and Jonathan my son will be on the other side.” The people said to Saul, “Do what seems good to you.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Therefore Saul said to the LORD, the God of Israel, “Show the right.” Jonathan and Saul were chosen, but the people escaped.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Saul said, “Cast lots between me and Jonathan my son.” Jonathan was selected.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then Saul said to Jonathan, “Tell me what you have done!” Jonathan told him, and said, “I certainly did taste a little honey with the end of the rod that was in my hand; and behold, I must die.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Saul said, “God do so and more also; for you shall surely die, Jonathan.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: The people said to Saul, “Shall Jonathan die, who has worked this great salvation in Israel? Far from it! As the LORD lives, there shall not one hair of his head fall to the ground, for he has worked with God today!” So the people rescued Jonathan, so he didn’t die.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: When he had finished speaking to Saul, the soul of Jonathan was knit with the soul of David, and Jonathan loved him as his own soul.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then Jonathan and David made a covenant, because he loved him as his own soul.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan stripped himself of the robe that was on him and gave it to David with his clothing, even including his sword, his bow, and his sash.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Saul spoke to Jonathan his son and to all his servants, that they should kill David. But Jonathan, Saul’s son, greatly delighted in David.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul my father seeks to kill you. Now therefore, please take care of yourself in the morning, live in a secret place, and hide yourself.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan spoke good of David to Saul his father, and said to him, “Don’t let the king sin against his servant, against David; because he has not sinned against you, and because his works have been very good toward you;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Saul listened to the voice of Jonathan; and Saul swore, “As the LORD lives, he shall not be put to death.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan called David, and Jonathan showed him all those things. Then Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was in his presence as before.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: David fled from Naioth in Ramah, and came and said to Jonathan, “What have I done? What is my iniquity? What is my sin before your father, that he seeks my life?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: David swore moreover, and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favor in your eyes; and he says, ‘Don’t let Jonathan know this, lest he be grieved;’ but truly as the LORD lives, and as your soul lives, there is but a step between me and death.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then Jonathan said to David, “Whatever your soul desires, I will even do it for you.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I should not fail to dine with the king; but let me go, that I may hide myself in the field to the third day at evening.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan said, “Far be it from you; for if I should at all know that evil were determined by my father to come on you, then wouldn’t I tell you that?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers you roughly?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan said to David, “Come! Let’s go out into the field.” They both went out into the field.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan said to David, “By the LORD, the God of Israel, when I have sounded out my father about this time tomorrow, or the third day, behold, if there is good toward David, won’t I then send to you and disclose it to you?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: The LORD do so to Jonathan and more also, should it please my father to do you evil, if I don’t disclose it to you and send you away, that you may go in peace. May the LORD be with you as he has been with my father.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: So Jonathan made a covenant with David’s house, saying, “The LORD will require it at the hand of David’s enemies.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan caused David to swear again, for the love that he had for him; for he loved him as he loved his own soul.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then Jonathan said to him, “Tomorrow is the new moon, and you will be missed, because your seat will be empty.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: The king sat on his seat, as at other times, even on the seat by the wall; and Jonathan stood up, and Abner sat by Saul’s side, but David’s place was empty.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: On the next day after the new moon, the second day, David’s place was empty. Saul said to Jonathan his son, “Why didn’t the son of Jesse come to eat, either yesterday, or today?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan answered Saul, “David earnestly asked permission of me to go to Bethlehem.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said to him, “Why should he be put to death? What has he done?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Saul cast his spear at him to strike him. By this Jonathan knew that his father was determined to put David to death.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: So Jonathan arose from the table in fierce anger, and ate no food the second day of the month; for he was grieved for David, because his father had treated him shamefully.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: In the morning, Jonathan went out into the field at the time appointed with David, and a little boy with him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: When the boy had come to the place of the arrow which Jonathan had shot, Jonathan cried after the boy, and said, “Isn’t the arrow beyond you?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan cried after the boy, “Go fast! Hurry! Don’t delay!” Jonathan’s boy gathered up the arrows, and came to his master.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: But the boy didn’t know anything. Only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan gave his weapons to his boy, and said to him, “Go, carry them to the city.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan said to David, “Go in peace, because we have both sworn in the LORD’s name, saying, ‘The LORD is between me and you, and between my offspring and your offspring, forever.’” He arose and departed; and Jonathan went into the city.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: Jonathan, Saul’s son, arose and went to David into the woods, and strengthened his hand in God.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: They both made a covenant before the LORD. Then David stayed in the woods and Jonathan went to his house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

sourceChecks.text: The Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文でサウルの子ヨナタン本人が名指される。

wikipediaArticleRead.title: Jonathan (1 Samuel)
wikipediaArticleRead.noteJa: 記事はサムエル記のヨナタンを扱い、サウルの子として紹介します。
wikipediaArticleRead.verifiedHeadingOrText: 記事冒頭はJonathanをサムエル記の人物、サウルの長男とDavidの親友と説明。§Conflicts with Saulは1 Samuel 13–14の出来事を扱う。

notesJa: 固定WEB全章の該当出現を候補ごとに照合し、別人の同名用例を除外。
authorRepairNotes: 1SA20:12の約束、20:16の契約、20:17の再度の誓いを分離し、各factの本文支持とsource gateを揃えた。
20:12/20:16/20:17 facts separated at their exact verse gates; Wikipedia Saul-parent fact gated to 13:16.
Wikipediaでサウルの長男と明記される関係情報を、固定WEBが初めて明示する13:16へgate。13:2/13:3の初出根拠から父子関係を除外。
